blurb: Offers group classes and private lessons in acting, dance, acro, musical theatre, voice, guitar, drums, and piano. Classes run from August 24, 2026 to June 10, 2027. Students perform in concerts and recitals with some classes requiring costume fees.
extraNote: $35 registration fee per student per year (max $105 per family) · Tuition payment options: annual with 5% discount, bi-annual with 3% discount, or monthly installments · Refund if student unenrolls before second class after first attended · 30-day written notice required to drop a class, no refunds but payments transferable within fiscal year · $20 late fee for tuition payments after 10th of the month · $20 declined card fee for declined auto-pay cards · August 24, 2026 through June 10, 2027
